visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical split-screen presentation. The top half shows a close-up of a person's hands gripping a large, pale green cabbage and slamming it three times against a reddish-brown wooden cutting board. The bottom half features a young man with long dark hair and a grey t-shirt, wearing a small astronaut pendant necklace, reacting with an exaggerated, wide-eyed expression of disbelief. The setting is a bright studio kitchen with wooden counters and turquoise cabinetry. (2) The perspective shifts to a single full-screen shot of the man standing in the same studio kitchen. He holds a whole cabbage above his head with both hands and slams it forcefully onto the wooden counter three times, following numbered on-screen instructions. He then reaches into the base of the cabbage, twists the central stem, and pulls it out completely intact, revealing a look of genuine surprise and excitement to the camera. (3) The man then moves to a comparison scene where he holds a cored cabbage in one hand and points to another shattered cabbage on the table, which he labels as a failure case. He gestures animatedly while explaining the technique, frequently bringing a fresh cabbage down onto the table with significant force. His facial expressions are highly dynamic, ranging from intense focus during the slamming action to comedic, wide-mouthed shouting while addressing the audience directly. (4) In the final sequences, the man displays the detached cabbage core closely to the lens, showcasing the success of the hack. He continues to hold the vegetable while making humorous remarks about stress relief, concluding the video by slamming a cabbage one last time onto the counter in a high-energy gesture. The lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the textures of the vegetable leaves and the man's lively facial reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with high-arousal male speech in Mandarin, characterized by rapid delivery and a bright, energetic tone. The background is filled with a bouncy, comedic synth-pop BGM featuring a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. Three loud, percussive thuds with sharp transients mark the moments the cabbage hits the table. (2) A vocal exclamation "Eh?!" occurs with a high-pitched rising intonation, followed by a crisp vegetable rustling sound as the core is removed. The BGM remains constant in tempo and volume, providing a rhythmic bed underneath the clear, professional-grade vocal recording. (3) The phase transitions into a sequence of rapid-fire speech segments interspersed with frequent, heavy thudding sounds of impact. Each cabbage strike is audibly distinct with a broad spectral footprint. The speaker's voice maintains a high activation level, fluctuating between explanatory narrative and excited shouting. (4) The final portion features a sudden increase in vocal loudness as the speaker shouts "Dui!" (Yes!) and laughs. A final, forceful thud coincides with a stinger sound effect, and the BGM abruptly cuts out as the video ends. The entire track exhibits high fidelity and a carefully balanced mix of voice and percussive Foley.

It utilizes a high-energy, comedic persona and rhythmic editing to turn a mundane kitchen task into a humorous stress-relief activity, encouraging viewers to share the content for its 'healing' and funny qualities.
